title: The write step writes WordPress pictures and addresses and empties demo words there, through the plugin's contract
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The WordPress door sends words, a picture rewritten to wp-content/uploads/tracy-content/<sha256>.<ext>, an address and an emptied text slot ('') in one apply; a picture taken off is refused by slot and skipped as not on WordPress yet; an upload goes to the plugin's folder; info carries hide_ops and a WordPress menu item holds no page; a whole JA Diner WordPress write step empties the plan's hidden text slot and the kept blocks' demo words.

tests: words, an address, a picture and emptied text go in one apply; a picture taken off is refused by slot, in words
the plugin info carries the hide orders this door makes (an emptied slot), and a WordPress menu item holds no page
a WordPress Diner run writes its words as plain text in one apply, and skips in words what the plugin does not take
